name: Azhagesan Ranganathan
summary: Software engineer with 4+ years of experience designing, developing and supporting enterprise applications. Focused on Java, Spring Boot, secure APIs and dependable banking systems.

details: Developed banking solutions for a Singapore-based financial institution, contributing to MRB and MCB modules across retail and corporate banking.
Developed and maintained Java and Spring Boot microservices, with RESTful APIs for banking operations and customer services.
Contributed application enhancements, bug fixes, production support, performance optimization and reliability improvements.
Used Linux, PuTTY and WinSCP for deployment, monitoring and troubleshooting.
Collaborated with business analysts, QA teams and stakeholders, following secure coding practices and banking standards.
Used Claude Code and AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency and code quality.
Gathered business requirements and translated them into technical specifications.
Built scalable backend modules with Java, Spring Boot and Hibernate; implemented RESTful APIs for frontend and third-party integration.
Integrated Spring Security for authentication and authorization.
Wrote SQL queries and used Spring Data JPA for database operations.
Participated in Agile ceremonies, used Git and JIRA, and supported UAT and post-production operations.
Provided ERP technical support and troubleshooting as the first point of contact for issues and service requests.
Managed ERP users and access controls; supported implementation, upgrades and patches.
Maintained data integrity through audits and validation, coordinating with vendors and internal teams to resolve issues.
